title: Pickle Ball,Heated Pool, Bar w/Swings,Games,Bocce!
description: If you're looking for a central Scottsdale location close to everything, look no further! This 7 bed/3 bath remodeled home is just 5 minutes from Kierland Commons, 10 mins from the WM Open & Barrett Jackson and 20 mins from the airport and Old town Scottsdale! Enjoy Top Golf/Talking Stick Casino and many other family-friendly activities in just 15 minutes. Just 3 miles to HW 101, this home is perfect for couples, business travelers & families alike and centrally located to everything Scottsdale!
